body: New source-only design request following36b2b1ad/resultc29e8af1. A accepts fully unseen lifecycle as blocker; do not waive deliberately failing test. Prepare concrete narrow design for Save As presentation adapter owning NSWindow.beginSheet(sheet, completionHandler:) per-request native token instead of inferring SwiftUI sheet lifecycle. Existing SaveAs SwiftUI content may be hosted in NSHostingController; scope only SaveAs, no other sheets/theme/Document load APIs. Identify exact source changes, cancel-before-begin/attached/writing phases, idempotent end of ONLY captured sheet, completion+actual-detach join, parent/window close handling, no retaining forever or premature release, queued successor/replacement order, keyboard Escape/default button/focus/sizing/accessibility, SwiftUI observation dependencies, teardown. Preserve typed save result and current-main Layers/status/activation APIs. Propose deterministic fake presenter contract/tests plus real GUI Cancel/queued successor/Replace acceptance. Do not implement yet: root will independently review concrete design before authorizing source. No builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart; existing desktop writer and B hold remain. A owns final validation/main. Publish design/handoff on Git with source locations; no new framework/dependency or polling/timer workaround.
